title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today following a recent episode of hypoglycemia.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports experiencing a hypoglycemic episode yesterday afternoon. Symptoms included dizziness and shakiness. This is an ongoing concern related to their management of type 1 diabetes. The patient confirms they are taking their prescribed insulin regimen as directed. They deny any recent changes to their insulin dosage or routine.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus management: Patient is compliant with insulin use, but requires monitoring for hypoglycemic episodes.
2. Hypoglycemia: Acute management discussed.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Reinforce signs and symptoms of hypoglycemia. Patient educated on recognizing and treating future hypoglycemic episodes. Follow up as needed.
explanations: Type 1 diabetes with hypoglycemia without coma: E10.649.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
